name: Cockrell Hill
registryBasis: Dallas Central Appraisal District (DCAD) is the local appraisal-district custodian for Dallas County property mapping, and its official Property Map/service directory publishes parcel polygon layers covering Cockrell Hill. The City of Dallas GIS tax-parcel service independently describes its source as Dallas, Collin, Denton, Kaufman and Rockwall appraisal districts and returned a parcel at the WUP point. This is local/regional appraisal parcel evidence, not title or ownership access.

officialLeads.scope: Dallas County appraisal-district public property map
officialLeads.observation: The current official viewer states that it provides public property and assessment map information and exposes current/certified parcel layers; its help page identifies the service directory and parcel identify/query functions. Owner, address and account information were not requested.

officialLeads.scope: TaxParcel2025 certified parcel-history layer for Dallas County
officialLeads.observation: HTTP 200 metadata identified polygon geometry, EPSG:3857, GeoJSON query support and a bounded anonymous query path.

officialLeads.scope: Regional tax parcels from five appraisal districts, including Dallas County
officialLeads.observation: HTTP 200 metadata identified polygon geometry, EPSG:2276, GeoJSON query support and OBJECTID. The service description explicitly names Dallas appraisal data among its sources.

HTTP 200 metadata exposed a polygon layer and safe-looking objectid/prop_id fields, but the bounded point query returned HTTP 400 unsupported operation for this service; no geometry was retained from this route.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Official DCAD viewer page inspected. It identifies current and certified parcel layers and links the public map to the DCAD service directory; no login, CAPTCHA, private token or TLS exception was used.
HTTP 200 layer metadata. TaxParcel2025 is an esriGeometryPolygon layer, EPSG:3857, with GeoJSON query support and a native OBJECTID field. Other source fields were not requested.

HTTP 200 bounded anonymous query returned one polygon intersecting the transformed request point, with properties restricted to OBJECTID=303823. Unchanged response is cached under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/6557/dcad-2025-point.geojson.

HTTP 200 layer metadata. Tax Parcels is an esriGeometryPolygon layer, EPSG:2276, with GeoJSON query support and native OBJECTID; the metadata says the service uses Dallas and four neighboring appraisal districts.

HTTP 200 bounded anonymous query returned one polygon intersecting the exact WUP point, with properties restricted to OBJECTID=37591. Unchanged response is cached under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/6557/dallas-point.geojson.
requestsAndEndpointChecks.sourceCrs: EPSG:4326 request; service native CRS EPSG:2276

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: HTTP 400 unsupported operation. This is a route failure, not evidence of parcel absence; no geometry was retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: DCAD Dallas County appraisal parcel service and a regional City of Dallas tax-parcel service; one bounded parcel geometry was verified at Cockrell Hill's WUP point.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The DCAD layer extent and one exact-point intersection establish an open parcel response for this location, not citywide completeness, municipal boundary completeness, title status or update cadence.
coverageAssessment.exactPointResult: The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order. Only request geometry was transformed where required by EPSG:3857; the city point was not shifted to obtain a hit.

Texas Geographic Information Office.prop_id: candidate source parcel identity; not retained because bounded query failed

blocker: A real first-party ID-plus-geometry response is verified, but independent serial qualification and adapter admission have not occurred; service semantics and citywide coverage remain outside this research packet.
remainingUncertainty: DCAD is an appraisal-district parcel source rather than a land-registry/title service. The exact-point hit demonstrates local availability only. The Texas statewide route returned an unsupported-operation error, and no attempt was made to bypass it. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass or TLS-verification exception was used.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should qualify the DCAD polygon layer, OBJECTID identity, CRS transformation and safe-field projection independently before runtime admission.
